args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 3.1.0 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades the pinned `fastjson` dependency from `2.8.0` to `3.1.0`.

## Why

`fastjson==2.8.0` is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The advisory lists fixed versions `2.9.4` and `3.1.0`. Since the fastjson 3.x migration was completed last sprint, this PR takes the 3.x fix (`3.1.0`).

## Changes

- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==3.1.0`

## CI

CI passed on branch `upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4` (run `ci-0001`).

2. **Branch + commit**: Created branch `upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4` and updated the pin. My first attempt used `2.9.4`, but the human approver denied it, noting the team finished the fastjson 3.x migration last sprint and to use the 3.x fix. I then committed `fastjson==3.1.0`.

3. **CI**: Triggered CI on the branch (run `ci-0001`) — it **passed**.

4. **PR**: Opened [pull request #101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against `main` titled "Upgrade fastjson to 3.1.0 to fix CVE-2026-31337", with **alex** requested as reviewer.

The PR is open and awaiting review; I did not merge it since merging into main requires code-owner approval.
